mission_10: Congratulations on completing the React chapter! You have mastered the full spectrum of React development: components and JSX, props and composition, state management with useState, side effects with useEffect, global state with Context, custom hooks, routing, performance optimization, testing, and advanced design patterns. The compound components, render props, HOCs, state reducers, and control props patterns you implemented are used by major component libraries like Material-UI and Radix UI. You are ready to build production React applications.
